source_edition: ISA Data Model Specification release 6.0 document revision 12, 31 October 2023

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Power, printed p.15 / PDF p.30
primary_records.proposed_label: Variable-power level as a percentage of the available maximum
primary_records.original_meaning: For a device supporting variable power, the given power level is expressed as a percentage of its maximum available power.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: This is not stored-energy percentage, consumed watts or a transmit-power measurement. The definition does not specify an input/output role or assert that a setting was commanded or applied. The Percent base type does not impose a universal 0–100 cap.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Power State, printed p.15 / PDF p.30
primary_records.proposed_label: Reported condition of power to the component
primary_records.original_meaning: The current condition of power to the component, expressed through General State: required code, optional component-specific machine subcode and optional human-readable details.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not a fabricated ON/OFF enumeration, the whole component operating condition, battery percentage, authorization state or independently verified supply condition. No live value is inferred.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Reserve Capacity, printed p.16 / PDF p.31
primary_records.proposed_label: Reported energy reserve relative to maximum capacity
primary_records.original_meaning: Current energy reserve as a percentage of maximum capacity, with fuel-tank and battery-level uses identified by the source. Measured Percent carries required value and optional error.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not rated mAh/Wh, available instantaneous power, remaining time or a measured value for a reference design. Optional error is not automatically zero; its native convention is plus/minus one standard deviation.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Satellites, printed p.16 / PDF p.31
primary_records.original_meaning: Number of satellites in use, encoded as Count with required integer value and optional integer error.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not satellites merely visible/available, a specified constellation, a count of installed receivers or evidence of position accuracy. No count, reset rule or fixed acquisition interval is invented.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Shots, printed p.16 / PDF p.31
primary_records.original_meaning: Number of times the laser has been used, encoded as Count with required value and optional error.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not firearm shots, a general observation count, or a guaranteed pulse-by-pulse count. The source does not define reset policy or a lifetime/time-window scope. A counter definition is not evidence that a particular laser fired.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Tamper State, printed p.17 / PDF p.32
primary_records.original_meaning: The tamper state of the device, using the shared General State structure and General Code enumeration.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Accepted extension, not core. No particular tamper detector, alarm, binary TAMPERED/UNTAMPERED enum, operator action or incident history is defined here; preserve the supplied code/subcode/details roles.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Temperature, printed p.17 / PDF p.32
primary_records.original_meaning: Internal temperature of the device, represented by Measured Celsius with required temperature value and optional error.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Accepted extension, not ambient-air temperature, a rated operating-temperature range or a specific case measurement. The Celsius type has source range [-273.15, infinity); optional error uses plus/minus one standard deviation and is not fabricated when absent.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Time to Empty, printed p.17 / PDF p.32
primary_records.proposed_label: Estimated time to empty under expected usage
primary_records.original_meaning: Time to empty based on expected usage, represented by Measured Secs with required value in seconds and optional error.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not an absolute exhaustion timestamp, unconditional runtime guarantee, observation resultTime, sample period or a source-specified prediction algorithm. Preserve its dependency on expected usage and the optional-error convention.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Count, printed p.91, PDF 106
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Core composite; source describes a positive integer count of occurrences or group members. Required value: Integer (1); optional error: Integer (0–1). Do not impose measured-float error conventions or invent reset/zero handling.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 Celsius, printed p.51, PDF 66
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Float temperature in degrees Celsius; range [-273.15, infinity). A type range is not the component operational temperature rating.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Measured Celsius, printed p.98, PDF 113
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required value: Celsius (1); optional error: Celsius (0–1). Supplied error is expressed as plus/minus one standard deviation. Absence does not supply perfect accuracy.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Measured Percent, printed p.103, PDF 118
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required value: Percent (1); optional error: Percent (0–1), expressed as plus/minus one standard deviation when provided.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Measured Secs, printed p.104, PDF 119
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required value: Secs (1); optional error: Secs (0–1), expressed as plus/minus one standard deviation when provided. Property context, not type alone, establishes expected time to empty.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 Percent, printed p.54, PDF 69
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Float relative to a maximum; 100 percent is considered the maximum but the base type allows exceeding it. No universal 0–100 clamp is imported.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 General State, printed p.93, PDF 108,109
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required General Code code; optional machine-readable component-specific subcode and human-readable details. Shared type does not merge power, operating or tamper conditions.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.1 General Code, printed p.79, PDF 94
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Sealed FAILURE, FAULT, OK, UNINITIALIZED and WARNING. Native distinctions remain; no invented power-specific or tamper-specific enum.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.1 String, printed p.50, PDF 65
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Previously checked native String definition; reused for General State optional subcode/details without adding encoding rules.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.1 Integer, printed p.50, PDF 65
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Previously checked native integer definition, reused for Count fields without redefining the property scope.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.1 Float, printed p.50, PDF 65
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Previously checked native floating-point type, reused by Celsius, Percent and Secs.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 Secs, printed p.55, PDF 70
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Floating-point seconds between instants; native representation has millisecond resolution. Not an absolute timestamp.

source_inspection.primary_text: DMS §3.1 printed pp.15–17 / PDF pp.30–32; original indexed source definitions and extension markings read.
source_inspection.atomic_type_text: Celsius p.51/PDF66 and Percent p.54/PDF69 original definitions checked; same-edition Float, Integer, String, Secs, General State and General Code evidence reused.

case_checks: No battery state inferred from Dragino or AirGradient design battery capacities.
Campbell Battery/LithiumBattery source voltages are not Reserve Capacity percentages.
Internal Temperature is not Bennett ambient ATemp; no internal temperature value is manufactured.
No satellites-in-use count, laser use count, tamper state or power condition is attributed to any example.
Original non-ISA donor cells and all source-case values are preserved.
mapping_note: Eight definitions convey eight distinct information roles; candidate rows record those roles rather than inferring values or adopting a DIM. These source terms do not close the broader original case-topic reconciliation automatically.
